market_summary: US stocks were mixed on Nov 18: the S&P 500 fell 0.2% for a fifth straight loss and the Dow fell 1.1%, while the Nasdaq rose 0.4% as Nvidia gave back early post-earnings gains. Minutes of the October FOMC showed nearly all officials expect further rate hikes, some backed a 25bp hike in October, and Governor Waller argued for tougher action; markets now price roughly a 90% chance of a December hike. Long-dated Treasuries still rallied for a third day, with the 10-year near 5.07-5.11% and the 30-year about 5.41%, helped by WTI crude dropping over 4% intraday to about $82, its lowest since August, on a US inventory build. The dollar index hit about 103.8, near its year high, and gold fell to its lowest since September 2025. Trump and Xi meet at the APEC summit in Shenzhen (Nov 18-19), where an extension of the trade truce is expected but outcomes are not yet reported.

AMZN.reason: Up 3.8% Nov 18, no single reported driver; AWS demand intact and Anthropic stake gets a public mark this week.

AXOS.reason: Flat Nov 18, no news. Cheapest name held at ~9x forward earnings.

BABA.reason: Fell 2.6% Nov 18 ahead of Sept-quarter results due before US open Nov 19; cloud growth is the number to watch.

FIGR.reason: Up 5.4% Nov 18 on no specific news; volatile.

LDI.reason: Up 6.5% Nov 18 on no news; no forward earnings and highly rate-sensitive with 10-yr near 5%.

MRVL.reason: Down 2.2% Nov 18 with chip names after Nvidia faded.

MU.reason: Down 1.0% Nov 18; forward PE ~4 reflects peak-cycle memory earnings.

NVDA.reason: Q3 beat and $130B Q4 guide, yet shares fell 2.9% Nov 18; CEO search and SEC probe weigh. Forward PE ~10.

TSM.reason: Up 0.8% Nov 18; Nvidia's $130B guide supports foundry demand.

STRIPE.reason: No new round or tender; Feb 2026 tender at $159B still the latest mark.

OPENAI.reason: No new mark since Nov 6 reported raise at $1.25T; mark unchanged.

headlines: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83, above the $70-78 range; ANT trades Thu US time (Fri morning AEDT).
Nvidia fell 2.9%, fifth straight drop, despite $130B guide; Moody's cut outlook to Stable on CEO exit.
Fed minutes: almost all officials see more hikes; markets price about 90% odds of a December hike.
Alibaba reports before US open tonight (about 10:30pm AEDT); cloud growth is the number.
Neocloud credit spreads widening; CoreWeave fell 4.1% Nov 18.
Other chips rallied: AMD +5.3%, NET +5.7%; LDI +6.5%, FIGR +5.4%.
